content-quality.text: The story names who, what and why, each requirement is observable from an exit, a log or a record field, and none prescribes more implementation than the mutation and the retained location.

requirement-completeness.text: The red names its command, its single change and four witnesses, and excludes setup and misattributed failures. The green reuses the same bindings. The identity fields are complete, the passing-mutant case has a bounded repair, and the exclusions are explicit.

readiness.text: No clarification is open, the limits are stated, and every requirement maps to a task.
